Confederate imprint. Map of the environs of Richmond showing location and dates of battles, roads, railroads, towns, names of counties, drainage, and the names of a few residents. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:160,000. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 639 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
